exercises: 뜻에 맞는 낱말을 고르세요. dog -> 개 / 게
뜻에 맞는 낱말을 고르세요. pear -> 배 / 베
빈칸에 알맞은 모음을 쓰세요. ㅊ_ㄱ (book): ㅐ / ㅔ / ㅖ
빈칸에 알맞은 모음을 쓰세요. ㅇ_쁘다 (to be pretty): ㅐ / ㅔ / ㅖ

letters.as: like the vowel in "bed" — in standard Korean slightly more open than ㅔ, but most Koreans today pronounce ㅐ and ㅔ the same; tell them apart by spelling

objective: Learners will read ㅐ and ㅔ as the same sound and learn which one each word uses by its spelling, and will pronounce ㅖ as [ye] in 예 and 례 (in other syllables such as 계, ㅖ may also be read [e], so 계란 can be read [계란] or [게란]) when reading simple words that contain these vowels.
summary: Practice reading the Korean vowels ㅐ, ㅔ, ㅖ in common words. Since most speakers pronounce ㅐ and ㅔ the same, learn each word's spelling. Read ㅖ as [ye] in 예 and 례; in other syllables such as 계, ㅖ may also be read [e] (계란 → [계란] or [게란]). Includes quick meaning and spelling choices to reinforce correct spelling.
